title: The Work Bears the Mantle: A Mantle Symbolon — the Good Gray Poet, the King of May, the Prince of Poets (EA-MANTLE-BEARING-01 v1.1)
sentence: The English the book transposes is Frederik Wisse's translation for *The Nag Hammadi Library in English*, online at [Early Christian Writings](https://www.earlychristianwritings.com/text/apocryphonjohn.html).
